verdict: ROAS surged this week; revenue is event-driven, not yet steady.
narrative: In the last 28 days, your Meta ads returned $3.29 for every $1 spent on $1,490.50 in spend — and the most recent 7 days saw ROAS jump 157.9% week-over-week, driven by a 33.33% rise in purchases. That said, purchases clustered across only 8 of the 28 days, meaning revenue is tied to demand spikes rather than a consistent daily baseline. The last 3 days recorded no purchases, which is a short-term stall we're watching closely as the next content push comes together. New video creative is being prioritized this week to broaden and stabilize the buying window heading into September.
